walkthroughs.body_html:
GCSE Modern Texts usually means one of: An Inspector Calls, Lord of the Flies, Animal Farm, Anita and Me.

All were written after 1914 and respond to a world shaken by two World Wars.

Priestley wrote this morality play in 1945 but set it in 1912. He attacks capitalism and argues for socialism.

The Inspector acts as the voice of social conscience.

Golding's novel is an allegory: stranded boys on an island become savage.

It argues that civilisation is a thin layer over human darkness — a response to the horrors of World War Two.
